flags.why: The meaning learners are more likely to encounter today is 'need not; have no need to', as reflected in this [dictionary entry](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/bat-tat-eOtXHCLfSH1RC.html).
The fruit name is mainly Northern, as explained by a textbook author in [this interview](https://vnexpress.net/khong-nen-dung-ky-nang-hoc-van-ngay-xua-de-day-tre-4179905.html).

The entry omits the common physical meaning 'hanging or floating in midair', illustrated by 'lửng lơ treo trước nhà' in [this teaching material](https://m.hoc247.net/tulieu/2022/20221024/157330294230_20221024_100946.pdf?r=4446).
flags.fix: Add: adj | hanging or floating in midair; suspended. Example: Những đám mây lửng lơ trên đỉnh núi. = Clouds float above the mountain peak.

flags.why: Đốn mạt is a strongly derogatory condemnation that can insult someone, as described in this [dictionary entry](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/don-mat-e9zcvceEgMnzU.html).
